newsitem.title: LEBANON: Shares steady on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Shares steady on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: The four active shares on the Beirut Stock Exchange were steady on Friday amid slightly lower overall turnover.
However, turnover in Solidere A shares continued at the high level it has set throughout the week with 102,046 shares changing hands compared with daily turnover of 40-50,000 in recent weeks.

Trade in Solidere A has jumped since the company's Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) began rising sharply on the London Stock Exchange last Friday. The GDRs were at $12.80 on Friday from $11.05 last Friday -- a 15.8 percent rise.

However, the GDR rise has not affected the Beirut price of Solidere shares. Solidere A were steady at $10.25, an alltime low, for the fifth successive day and B shares were unchanged at $10.75. B share turnover was 32,308.
Banque Audi was steady at $18 for the fourth successive day and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce, the other listed bank, was unchanged at $12.875
Audi turnover was 27,850 from 32,434 on Thursday, and another 26,300 shares were traded outside the floor at $18. BLC turnover was 19,921 from 17,435 a day earlier.
Total BSE turnover was 174,390 shares for a value of $2,062,680 against 187,269 shares for a value of $2,222,950 a day earlier.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Ciments Libanais, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM and LISPI indexes were unchanged at 896.53 and 81.88.
